Anderson’s

Cracking jig from the new Daimh album, “Diversions”. They play in in the D but tuned up a semi-tone to Eb. I’ve submitted it in the most session friendly key for the tune.

First tune here…. http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7pdKOTd0KyE

↳ Posted by bogman on November 17th, 2010.

Re: The Independent

From the insert accompanying “Makin’ The Rounds” by Billy McComiskey [ 1981 ] :
Track #2 [ jigs ] - “The Independent / Rabbit In The Field”.
“These are two tunes I made up myself. I wrote the first while taking the Independent Line subway home from work in New York about 10 years ago. I played it once or twice for Paddy O’Brien of Nenagh, Co. Tipperary. He played it back to me and suggested the variations included here”.

↳ Posted by Kenny on April 26th, 2020.
